scientific_integrity: Integral homotopy claim supported by a complete finite acyclic matching and exact signed boundary; finite modular checks are independent corroboration, not proofs of the integral statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for the ordinary matching complex of C5 Cartesian K2; neither all circular ladders nor equivariant homotopy types are determined. An equivalent unindexed result remains possible.
title: Integral homotopy type of the ordinary matching complex of the pentagonal prism
